nextStoryContext: US-003 added a fifth 'Setup checklist' section to composePrBody (src/release/pr-body.ts), rendered last (after Notes). A private SETUP_CHECKLIST_CUES array (regex pattern + item/where/how strings) covers env-var, migration, install/dependency, credential/API-key/OAuth, webhook, and generic config cues; renderSetupChecklist(prd) builds one haystack string from prd.description + prd.notes + every story's title (PrdSnapshotStory has no notes field, so per-story notes are NOT scanned -- constrained to what PrdSnapshot already carries, per this story's own notes field and the new patterns.md bullet on pure-composer purity vs. the reporter's diff-scanning ralph-ship.md Step 14 blueprint). Zero cue matches renders the empty-state line 'No manual setup actions detected.' (never an empty table); one or more matches renders a '| # | Item | Where | How | Status |' header + '| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |' divider + one numbered row per matched cue with a literal 'pending' Status cell (plain ASCII, no checkbox glyph, to stay consistent with the existing no-em-dash persisted-artifact rule already tested in this file). composePrBody stays pure (no I/O added). .claude/commands/cam-ship.md and templates/commands/cam-ship.md both got one sentence added to the existing ship-path paragraph documenting all five PR-body sections including Setup checklist (byte-identical dual-copy preserved via diff check); src/vendor/_generated.ts was regenerated (bun run embed-vendor) since templates/ changed. test/release/pr-body.test.ts gained a new 'composePrBody Setup checklist' describe block (5 tests: section ordering after Notes, empty-state line + absence of the table header, table+header rendering when an env-var/webhook cue is detected via description text, cue detection from a story title alone with no description/notes, and sequential 1-based row numbering across two matched cues). All gates green: typecheck 0 errors, bun test 4898 pass/0 fail (full suite, no pre-existing failures touched), bun run check:all clean (lint/file-size/debt-markers/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps all ok), embed-vendor:check clean after regeneration. No file-size ceiling raise was needed (pr-body.ts is not a budgeted file in scripts/file-size-budget.json; check-file-sizes.ts's checkSizeCeilings silently skips any path with no ceiling entry). A future story wanting diff-aware setup-checklist detection (matching the reporter blueprint's actual git-diff scan of .env.example/vercel.json/migration files) would need an impure caller-side pre-scan merged into the PrdSnapshot before composePrBody is invoked, not a widening of this function's own I/O surface.
